content.short: Ankr NFT API enables developers to query NFT metadata across six compatible blockchains.
content.description: Released in 2022 as a JavaScript-based toolkit, this NFT API provides a single, unified way to request NFT data across six EVM-compatible networks: Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Fantom, and Avalanche. It is designed to simplify data retrieval for owners, collections, minting times, transaction histories, and wallet-address listings. With one request, developers can obtain the essential NFT information they need to power apps, analytics, and dashboards.
